'''Chemilizards''', originally known as [[orpali dragon]]s, were [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] life forms native to [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]]. After the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]]' [[Terraforming/Legends|terraforming]] and polluting of the environment, these lizards evolved to be able to extract nutrients out of the chemical pollutants that would [[Death/Legends|kill]] most other living creatures.<ref name="LoNH" /> They also developed a unique coloring pattern and acidic saliva.<ref name= "swtor">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>

[[Voontara Fa'athra]] kept several chemilizards in the beast pit of [[Fa'athra's Palace|his palace]].
